TRACE_ASSERTIONS.ASSERTION: Installer dry-run maps Linux x86_64, Linux aarch64, macOS Intel, and macOS arm64 hosts to declared release artifacts; release artifact installs verify SHA256SUMS before extraction.

Installer source fallback uses cargo install --locked from SYN_INSTALL_SOURCE_REF in CI, from the selected Git tag when it exists, or from the default main branch during a pre-tag release-candidate window.
Release-candidate dry-run revalidates supported Linux/macOS installer mappings before any release publishing path and keeps Windows packaging deferred until artifacts and installer mapping exist.

Installer diagnose mode reports supported Linux/macOS artifact mapping including macOS Intel, independent OS and architecture support status, install directory status, required tool availability, checksum verifier status, Windows packaging deferral, and SYN_INSTALL_DIR guidance without writing files.
Release-candidate workflow captures public installer fresh smoke evidence on Linux/macOS with a temporary SYN_INSTALL_DIR.
Installer default version follows the current fresh release line so source fallback and artifact lookup do not target stale release tags.
